name: Kokuhatsu no Daishou Saeki Kazumi
original_name: 告発の代償 佐伯一美
source:
Kazumi gets a job at a major food company after graduation. But after she gets promoted to food control section, she fiercely opposes violations, which often results in firm closure. Main character's food factory gets closed down because of Kazumi's accusations. He has nothing to lose now, but he knows the exact person who is responsible for ruining his life ...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
毕业后和美在一家大型食品公司就职。但当她升任食品管理部门后，她强烈反对违规行为，这常常导致企业倒闭。主角的食品工厂因和美的指控而被关闭。他现在已经没有什么可失去的了，但他知道到底是谁毁了他的生活……
